contexts.text: Truth in the exterior Natural appears to be given freely. Signified, Explained. AC 5657.
When he reflects, he perceives that (all this knowledge and intelligence) is given him by the Lord through that angelic Society, freely.
In the other life, they perceive what is given them freely.
a. 4. They are given him freely by the Lord, every moment...
In the seventh year he shall go out free for nothing () = a state of confirmed truth without his works... For nothing = without their works.
The same is signified by freely in, I will give... of the fountain of the water of life freely (); and in, Let him take the water of life freely ().
She shall go out free without money () = alienation therefrom without truth conjoined therewith.
The houses in which the Angels dwell... are given them by the Lord, freely...
All these things come from the Lord freely; they are clothed freely, they are fed freely, they dwell in houses freely. HH 393:end. DLW 334. AE 1226:2. DLove 12:2.
To give freely () = from the Lord, and not from any self-derived intelligence of man.
Whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely = that he who from love is willing to learn truths and appropriate them to himself, will receive them from the Lord without his own works.
To be sold for nought () = to estrange one's self and to renounce falsities from self or from proprium.
That they should be given freely by the Lord. Signified.
